question: In February 2023, which high court ordered that even foreigners can invoke Domestic Violence Act, 2005 in Indian courts and that the residence of women is immaterial?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Madras**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Madras High Court** ruled in **February 2023** that even foreigners can invoke the **Domestic Violence Act, 2005** in Indian courts.
 
• The court emphasized that the residence of women is immaterial in invoking the provisions of the Domestic Violence Act.
